description: Pillar overrides for Oil & Gas. Replaces Carbon Offsetting with Well Decommissioning, the primary long-term environmental liability for E&P operations.

offsetting.label: Well Decommissioning
offsetting.description_override: Manage end-of-life well obligations and stranded asset liabilities.

decommissioning_trust.title: Establish Decommissioning Trust Fund
decommissioning_trust.description: Set aside ring-fenced decommissioning reserves from first production revenues, meeting international OPITO standards.

phased_decommission.title: Phased Decommissioning Plan
phased_decommission.description: Develop a 10-year phased decommissioning roadmap with regulatory sign-off.

defer_decommission.title: Defer Decommissioning Provisions
defer_decommission.description: Delay decommissioning liabilities to improve near-term reported profits. Regulatory and financial risk accumulates.
